title: Back to Square One
summary: This year is going to be different, or not? After the tanker freight market recovered in the fourth quarter of 2018, most analysts (including ourselves) expected that the beginning of 2019 would show better earnings than the comparable period of last year. Unfortunately, that has not been the case.
